entities.summary: Oury Amos Cherki is an Israeli Orthodox rabbi, chairman of Brit Olam – The World Center for Bnei Noah, a senior lecturer at Machon Meir, leader of congregation "Bayit Yehuda" in the Kiryat Moshe neighborhood of Jerusalem, and has published numerous works on Jewish thought and Jewish philosophy.
